ns2:section.sectionText: Priority registration given to Juniors and Seniors in Food Science until the beginning of Sophomore registration, then open to Food Science minors and all FSHN undergrad and grad students. The Non Majors section will open to all campus Seniors at the start of Freshman registration.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Food Science & Human Nutrition or Food Science or Human Nutrition or Dietetics or Hospitality Management or Food Science or Nutrition major(s) or minor(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
